program.ge_pattern: Columbia College General Education (CC-GE) Pattern or California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) Pattern
outcomes: Demonstrate the knowledge and skills to industry standards needed as an entry-level Emergency Medical Technician.
Apply the fundamental knowledge and skills related to the field of Emergency Medical Services.
Communicate necessary care and medical terminology for emergency situations.

notes: Codes are written as the catalog prints them without spaces (BIOL10 = BIOL 10, STATC1000 = STAT C1000, etc.); all match the closed list.
Electives list prints 'OR higher than SPAN1 4 units' after SPAN1: any higher-level Spanish course may substitute for SPAN1; no specific code is named, so no alternative was recorded.
'60 Total Units Required' is printed in the award's unit requirements header and recorded as degree_total; no GE unit figure is printed.
Student chooses one of two GE patterns (CC-GE or Cal-GETC).

The description repeats the outcomes lead-in ('Upon satisfactory completion of this award, the student should be prepared to:') with nothing under it; the outcomes are printed later under the Program Learning Outcomes heading.
Careers 'First Responders', 'Law Enforcement', 'Military personnel' are taken from the program description; 'Emergency Medical Technician' from the first outcome.
